name: Valley of the Wolves
description: One of Turkey's most iconic and influential dramas, Valley of the Wolves follows Polat Alemdar, an undercover agent who infiltrates Istanbul's most dangerous crime organisation after years of preparation. Combining organised crime, covert operations and sharp political commentary, the series fearlessly tackles Turkey's shadowy relationship between the state, the mafia and power — and became a cultural phenomenon that spawned multiple films and spin-offs.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Ali Candan returns from Kosovo, Süleyman Cakir executes The Three Assasinations. Tombalaci Mehmet joins Council of the Wolves.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Sevko is disturbed by the Three Assassinations committed by Cakir. Aslan Akbey transforms Ali Candan into Polat Alemdar for an uphill struggle. Ali now has to get used to his new face and identity.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The Wolves Council has two candidates for the opening of a new casino; Sevko and Cakir. The casino affair will increase the tension between Sevko and Cakir.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The name of Polat Alemdar has created a shock effect in the underworld of Istanbul. The enmity between Sevko and Cakir will create a new friendship between Polat and Cakir. With Duran Emmi's move, Polat steps into the Valley of the Wolves.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The power struggle between Cakir and Sevko intensifies. Sevko's authority in the Istanbul underworld is questioned by the Wolves Council.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After the assassination attempt against Cakir and Duran Emmi by Sevko is blocked by Polat, Polat take out a sword on Sevko.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Sevko made Polat a matter of honor. Sevko made an agreement with Cakir for Polat, but this agreement did not go as expected.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Polat and Cakir's game against Sevko created a great opportunity for Cakir. Istanbul's biggest crime bosses will meet at the grand opening ceremony of Cakir's casino.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: After Cakir executes Tombalaci Mehmet, the Wolves Council questions Cakir and Polat's place in the underworld. Karahanli orders Cakir to head the Istanbul mafia in order to learn the mystery behind Polat.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Suleyman Cakir became the head of the Istanbul mafia. A meeting is held with the crime bosses in Istanbul, but the organized crime organization "Cerrahpasas", which does not respect Cakir, will cause trouble.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Cakir's crew changes the order of the drug trade belonging to the Cerrahpasas' crew. In the Cakir-Cerrahpasas mob conflict initiated by Polat, the balances change in the Istanbul mafia.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: The drug trafficking belonging to Necmi, who is a member of the wolves council, has been affected by the mob war between Cakir and Halit. Due to this war, various problems will befall the crime bosses in the underworld in Istanbul.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Cerrahpasa gang organizes various attacks on Cakir's places. Polat and Abdulhey went to a coffee house in the Cerrahpasa gang's area to intimidate.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: After the assassination attempt against Karahanli is prevented by Aslan Akbey's operation, there is internal turmoil in the Wolves Council. Karahanli conveys his decision to Testere Necmi about the Cakir-Cerrahpasas gang war.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: After Cerrahpasa gang leader Halit's armed attack, Cakir fights for his life in the hospital. Polat decides to go to the crime bosses of Istanbul's underworld.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: With the death of Cakir, Polat's murder of six crime bosses in one night left a shock effect in the underworld of Istanbul.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: After Laz Ziya's genius move, the Wolves Council determined Polat's fate. The hostility between Testere Necmi and Polat will intensify.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Laz Ziya and Hüsrev Agha accuse Testere Necmi of treason. The Wolves Council has to make a decision about Testere Necmi.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Polat finds the mole in Aslan Akbey's secret organization. Polat makes a plan for Kirkor Terzioglu the moneylender, who is the source of millions of dollars transferred to Cakir's bank account.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: The narcotic seizure of the drug-laden ship "Lucky-S" and the allegations about Cakir confused the Wolves Council. The conflict between Polat and Testere Necmi has now turned into a serious animosity.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: The cold breath of death is on Aslan's neck. Elif, unaware of the gun pointed at her at Ali's grave, is about to unravel the mystery. Safiye is trying to reach the mysterious person in her father's house, where she came after 30 years. Will Testere Necmi, who is trapped, be able to resist death any longer? Will Nesrin avoid the same fate as her mother? Why did the Baron stop when he broke Polat's pen? Who does the scream coming from the roof belong to? How will the new structure in the Council be? The balance in the Valley is upside down and Polat is at a crossroads... And the encounter that shocks Polat...

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: 30 years of secrets...Barrels in heads, lethal questions...While Polat is searching for the “will” in Aslan's house, Abdülhey faces another face of the power, the “state” that took him out of the orphanage and raised him...Baron asks Kılıç, “Did you see what I saw?” Kılıç searches for the answer in the cut on his face, 30 years flash before his eyes...Baron asks about Polat, Safiye asks about Nergiz, Elif asks about Ali, Hikmet asks about Aslan. Polat asks himself, “Who am I?” In Valley of the Wolves, who you are is not written on your ID card!

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: A 30-year secret in the black book... Polat is baffled by the will left by Aslan and searches for his past between the pages... Elif questions everyone in her life. “Everyone in my life is a lie!” The questions in Hikmet's mind are looking for answers. How will the balance be in Baron's new council? Who will take part in the Russian Council formed against Baron's council? Both Polat and the cops are after the envelope left behind by Aslan Akbey... Who is the real owner of the relic delivered to Ömer Efendi? Safiye is with her mother after many years... Elif and Canan are at a crossroads... Hüsrev Ağa's hard day... Elif's tense wait... How will the result from Forensic Medicine affect Elif's life? The curtain of mystery in the valley is waiting to be lifted...

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Will Polat succeed in getting the envelope left by Aslan from Doğu Bey? Mehmet Karahanlı is at the prosecutor's office... Everyone is surprised to learn that Ali is not dead... And they are looking for answers to their questions about Ali's existence... Doğu Bey is on countdown to solve the murder of Aslan Akbey... Polat is facing a new face of the state... Who is Pala? How does Abdülhey know Pala? Doğu Bey takes action to bring KGT back to life. Kılıç questions his past and present in front of Nergiz. Safiye is looking for a cure to bring her mother back to life. Will the new doctor succeed in bringing Nergiz back to life? Elif takes her anger at Ali out on Polat. Hüsrev Aga and Baron face each other again after the tension in the council... In Valley of the Wolves, the sword has no scabbard.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: After Hüsrev Aga's death, the balance in the Council is shifting. Who will take Husrev Aga's place? Will Polat tell the truth to Doğu Bey and will he fulfill the order given by Doğu Bey? Who does the Baron want from Polat? Elif is resorting to a new way to find out Ali's fate, but will she be able to reach Ali this time? Karahanlı answers the accusations against him in front of the media. Nergiz confronts her life in her dream... Ömer Baba is at the grave of his son Ali and Nazife Anne asks Polat for help. Nesrin says goodbye to her children. Laz Ziya's will to Polat and his request in return... And Polat and his team are in operation...

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Pala is being interrogated, his hands tied, facing East and Polat. Polat has buried his anger at Aslan's murderer, he wants to hear the name of the power that gave the order! Bedir stands in front of Mito. He says they are planting bombs all over Istanbul and wants Pala released. Polat is on his way to kidnap Halil İbrahim Kapar, a convicted drug smuggler in prison! Will Polat be able to kidnap Halo despite the physical impossibility? Who will be the "deep" obstacle? The adventure never ends in Valley of the Wolves!

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: An unforgettable escape! Halo is in the helicopter, a breathless chase begins... Pala is chasing Halo as he escapes from his grasp. Will Polat achieve the impossible? Halo is devastated when he learns the identity of the person who sold him... Russian Baron Ibrahim wants Polat in his ranks. Dogu Bey says his last word to Mito after the Pala incident. Pala tries to unravel the identity of Polat and his men. Elif does not give up her stubbornness and tries to find Ali from her orphanage years.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Tensions rise in the Valley as Seyfo Dayı faces Pala's gun. Mito demands Faruk and Pala's heads from Bedir, testing his loyalty. Sabahat, disturbed by Elif and Canan's unexpected visit, meets Doğu Bey, who then investigates old files, confronting the past. Canan, Eren, and Deli Hikmet secretly search Sabahat's house for a mysterious third person in a photograph. Mito reveals Abbas Ustaoğlu's murderer to Samuel. After 30 years, Nergiz stands alone, bringing joy to Safiye. Nesrin tells Polat about Russian Baron İbrahim's offer. Halo and Akrep Bekir face off after seven years. Polat and his team devise a new plan to reach Pala, leading to a standoff.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Pala is under Polat's feet, on the line between life and death... Will Polat get what he wants from Pala? There is mourning in Seyfo's coffee house; the last bully is becoming history. Mito investigates the third person in the picture brought by Elif. Doğu Bey wants the truth about Ali Candan. Everyone in the valley is curious about the identity of the third person in the photo. Safiye asks Kılıç about the scar on his face. Sabahat Hanım goes to Ömer Baba's house after what happened and encounters the unexpected reaction of Nazife Anne. Polat asks who Kirve is... Questions are answered at the most unexpected moments! The past is not talked about in Valley of the Wolves.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Kirve's arrival stirs up the Valley as he begins his meetings. Polat shares what he learned from Pala with Kılıç. Erhan awaits Polat's decision about him, and Polat asks him for something difficult. Halo assumes a new identity. Elif's attempts to gather information about the photograph are unsuccessful, but the photo itself causes chaos. Nizamettin shows the photo to Baron, who decides to unravel the coincidences. Meanwhile, Nergiz manages to stand on her own once again.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Feraye is dying on the ground, leaving Baron shocked. He calls Kılıç, unaware that Kılıç is pursuing a mysterious figure seen leaving Sabahat's house. Baron then considers another name: Polat. Elif struggles to accept Sabahat's death and questions whether to continue her quest, realizing how she's endangered others for Ali's sake. Memati makes a choice between Polat and the streets. Baron calls Polat, giving him an unexpected opportunity as Baron is vulnerable at home. Polat investigates Feraye's past and confronts Baron with a surprise.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Polat asks Karahanlı for full authority over his security. Kirve tries to recruit Akrep Bekir and Laz Ziya to his side. Nergiz asks Baron about Polat's identity, expressing her desire to know him. At Karahanlı's dinner, Polat, Kılıç, Nergiz, and Safiye come together. Elif questions Nesrin about choosing her as a lawyer. Nesrin promises Memati great power and asks for his loyalty. While pursuing Armatör, Memati encounters an unexpected figure.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Baron meets with Samuel and confronts Polat with a new plan. Elif files her lawsuit and finds herself face-to-face with Nizamettin. Nesrin prepares a bigger surprise for Laz Ziya. Unaware of Kirve's plan, Halo continues collecting drugs from the market. Kirve learns that Memati left the bullet and confronts Laz Ziya. Meanwhile, Memati makes the most difficult decision of his life when facing Nesrin.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Tension escalates between Polat and Laz Ziya, who demands Memati's head. Polat's plans are disrupted by a call from Memati. Learning about his daughter's guardianship lawsuit, Laz Ziya orders Yahya to find Nesrin and the children. Polat is furious upon discovering Elif filed the lawsuit on Nesrin's behalf and intervenes. Now, both Memati and Nesrin are in danger. Polat devises a strategy to stop Elif. The lawsuit pits two close friends against each other as Nizamettin wants Canan to handle the case. Polat seeks Karahanlı's advice before acting against Laz Ziya.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Amid a hail of bullets, Abdülhey and Memati panic while Polat remains calm. Escaping Yahya's men proves challenging for Polat this time. At Polat's office, a bored Erhan decides to neutralize the waiting men his own way. Nesrin, the cause of the chaos, seeks refuge in what she considers the safest place. Nergiz becomes frantic when she can't find Safiye, who has managed to leave the house and visits Ömer Efendi to question happiness. Memati, unable to accept Nesrin's actions, decides to seek revenge alone but faces an unexpected surprise.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Memati fights for survival in a Russian trap. Nesrin negotiates with Selim to save Memati. Doğu Bey seeks Polat's help to control the Chechens; Polat agrees but sets a condition. Unable to reconcile with her father, Safiye turns to her mother for help. Laz Ziya and İbrahim Ahıskalı confront each other, with Selim planning a surprise for Nesrin and Laz Ziya for both. Unable to reach Memati, Adnan and Erdoğan inform Polat of the situation. The question remains: Can Polat save Memati, who has been left to die on the streets for the sake of those very streets?

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Memati fights for his life in intensive care while Polat vows revenge. Laz Ziya confronts İplikçi Nedim upon learning his money was given to the Chechens without his knowledge. The Chechens receive $680,000 from İplikçi Nedim, but Polat's new plans are disrupted by an unexpected person. Elif, removed from the case, visits Polat and learns about Memati's condition. A mysterious postcard given to Safiye causes turmoil in Baron's house. Polat raids Selim's home after learning of Nesrin's planned marriage to Selim. Doğu Bey meets with Karahanlı to uncover the truth about Ali Candan, providing Karahanlı with an answer to a 30-year-old question.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Doğu Bey visits Cyprus to discuss its past and future with TRNC President Rauf Denktaş, uncovering hidden truths and facing a surprise upon return. Baron visits the Candan family to learn everything about Ali Candan, shocking Nazife Hanım and Ömer Efendi. Elif talks to Nergiz and Safiye about Ali. Baron informs Nizamettin and Samuel, urging them to find his son. Polat reveals his terms to Laz Ziya and Nesrin, gaining the upper hand. Baron demands Polat kill Doğu Bey, but Polat devises a new plan instead of turning against the state that created him. However, his plans are disrupted by unexpected revelations.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Believing he's exposed, Polat considers killing Doğu, facing a crucial decision for himself and his mission. He struggles to accept Mehmet Karahanlı as his real father and dreads confronting Elif. While Baron reports to the temple, Polat tries to prove Ali Candan is not Efe Karahanlı. Kılıç waits for Baron's meeting to end, unaware of recent developments. Nergiz becomes ill due to her dreams, and Safiye fears her mother's relapse. The "temple hosts" lose patience with the Turkish Baron's incompetence. A sense of impending doom falls over the Valley of the Wolves.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Baron's death triggers various scenarios. Safiye fears losing her mother after her father and suspects Kılıç as the killer. Nergiz unexpectedly remains calm, focusing on shaping the future for Efe. Unable to reach Polat, Abdülhey discovers execution plans and wants to eliminate everyone on the list. Polat's unusual reactions catch Elif's attention as he begins to piece things together. Polat prepares for a final confrontation with Baron.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: The Council convenes to elect a new Baron, with candidates revealing their intentions and a cold war beginning among them. The presence of three candidates threatens to divide the Council. Mehmet Karahanlı's will is read, revealing Efe Karahanlı as an heir with a billion-dollar inheritance. Doğu makes a surprise visit to Polat, advising caution amid shifting alliances. Meanwhile, Polat waits for his appointment with Elif, torn between revealing the truth or keeping silent, a moment that may stretch into eternity.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: The Council prepares to reconvene to elect the new Baron, with final strategies being played out. Laz Ziya's blackmail forces Samuel to withdraw his candidacy, while Kirve aims to keep Halo away from the vote. Kılıç tries to persuade the key figure, Nizamettin. However, unexpected developments await the Council, leaving Laz Ziya feeling excluded. Safiye seeks to unravel the mysteries surrounding her father's death. Polat investigates Elif's kidnapping, suspecting Russians, Samuel, Kirve, and Laz Ziya, making moves against each but failing to find Elif. A shocking surprise awaits Polat just as hope seems lost.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Elif can't remember who kidnapped her or what happened. Polat tries to decipher a message sent with Elif and consults Doğu, having made a decision about his next move. Laz Ziya seeks revenge against those who plotted against him. The Russian Baron orders Polat's assassination. Kirve plans to eliminate Kılıç and the Karahanlı family. Safiye believes her father's killers are the same people who kidnapped Elif. Polat promises Elif to fulfill her every wish for 24 hours. However, Nina's gun barrel is poised to catch the star-crossed lovers during their intimate moment.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Nina's assassination attempt fails due to Erhan's detection. While Polat enjoys romantic moments with Elif, he also implements his plans. Abdülhey delivers Kirve to Halo, who seeks revenge for his murdered loved ones. Nergiz visits Polat to thank him for saving her and her daughter's lives, giving him the ring she kept for Efe. Polat solves the mystery of the fourth picture in his office. Samuel is surprised when Tuncay, Halo, and Kılıç attend the council meeting. A new baron is elected, leaving Samuel as the most disappointed person.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Laz Ziya receives visitors who don't want him to withdraw from business. Memati tries to get information about state connections from Abdülhey. Nina is held in a cell, asked to provide information in exchange for her life, but an unexpected development occurs. Safiye gets an appointment with Samuel, which Polat incorporates into his plans to provoke Samuel into making a mistake. Polat meets with Doğu for the first time since becoming Baron, discussing the Russians' anticipated major move. Polat suspects Samuel of collaborating with the Russians. Despite Doğu's warnings, Mito reconnects with Samuel to play their final cards, but Doğu intercepts this move. A package arrives at Polat's office

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Mito fails to commit suicide and wants to meet Samuel but mysteriously disappears. Safiye receives surprising online messages about Karahanlı's death and Dikilitaş. Elif finds a castle as Polat requested and decides to move there despite criticism. Polat's team plans to expand through legal businesses. Polat receives briefings from Kılıç and Nizamettin about the council's operations, which essentially explain how Turkey is governed. Meanwhile, while Polat is with Elif, Nina seizes Erhan's gun, shoots him and Abdülhey, aiming to escape from Polat's grasp as quickly as possible.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Polat uses Nina to reach the Russians, having her followed to uncover connections. Safiye receives new messages; Nergiz believes "fox" is someone who knows them. Laz Ziya ignores Akrep Bekir's calls to return, sensing impending trouble. İplikçi Nedim, who launders the council's illegal money, presents his file to Polat, explaining how economies influence power shifts and foreign capital enters the country. Tuncay's file covers cash and human trafficking, detailing how the new EU constitution could disrupt Turkey's political structure. The final person reached through Nina is revealed to be the Russians' most dangerous weapon.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Esad raids with commando units to capture Tilki Andrei alive, but Tilki kills Nina, leaves a message for Polat, and vanishes. Messages to Safiye advise her to focus on foundation work. Nergiz is now certain that "Fox" is Samuel. Laz Ziya takes action to secure his position. Nizamettin gives a press interview about principled revolutions in the new Turkish Penal Code. Halo briefs Polat on the massive increase in Afghan opium production after U.S. intervention. Samuel's file contains detailed information about world-controlling foundations, their structures, and operations. They discuss the U.S. economy's final move against Germany, Japan, and China. After meeting Tilki, Russian İbrahim convenes his council, marking the beginning of his inescapable end.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: A fitting end awaits Akrep Bekir, who becomes part of Polat's plans through Halo. This allows Memati to eliminate İbrahim Ahıskalı and his council. However, Halo distrusts Akrep Bekir, believing that once a traitor, always a traitor. Laz Ziya shares files with Doğu Bey as his "retirement insurance." Safiye begins working with Samuel to continue her father's foundation work, intending to gather information about him while pretending to be manipulated. Elif wants to return to her old job but turns to Polat when she learns it's impossible. Polat has Laz Ziya arrested and sends Akrep Bekir into Tilki Andrei's hands, leading to a fate befitting Akrep Bekir's name.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: During an argument with Polat, Elif chooses Ali after a long time. Laz Ziya accepts the warning given to him and doesn't provide information against the council while in custody. Nesrin agrees to take over her father's business. Tilki Andrei visits Polat, demanding Samuel in exchange for Ahıskalı, and kidnaps Polat's men to increase his bargaining power. A mysterious force begins implementing its own plans beyond everything else, messaging Safiye as "fox" while digitally imitating Polat's and Ali's voices. Meanwhile, Samuel discovers that Polat is Efe Karahanlı.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Is Fox really Tilki Andrei? Andrei breaks his promise to Polat and starts killing Polat's men before the deadline. Samuel's fate shocks everyone. Polat urges council members to flee Turkey quickly. Nizamettin finds a way to turn this death to their advantage, becoming the spokesperson for a "Clean Society" campaign with Polat's permission. Doğu suspects recent events were planned in Ankara and decides to intervene. Before the shock of Samuel's death subsides, news breaks of Safiye's kidnapping. Kılıç believes "fox" is Tilki Andrei and reaches him, only to face an unpleasant surprise. Meanwhile, the mysterious force continues to implement its plans.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: Polat wakes up in Syria after being buried alive in a coffin, finding himself in a hotel with a note containing a name. As he tries to reach the person named and contact Istanbul, chaos unfolds there: Elif has had an accident, Safiye has been kidnapped, Nergiz's old health issues resurface, and Tuncay and İplikçi Nedim are detained by police while trying to flee Turkey. Kılıç falls into a trap while searching for Tilki Andrei. Nizamettin seems indifferent to these problems, while Halo's escape plan appears smooth. Polat, unaware of all this, is prevented from reaching Istanbul. Upon finding the person mentioned in the note, Polat discovers a bag left for him. As he tries to piece everything together, the Syrian Secret Service, Al-Mukhabarat, is on his trail.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: Polat recalls his near-death experience in the coffin and how he was revived. In exchange for his new life, he's tasked with assassinating the Lebanese Prime Minister. While under constant surveillance, Polat investigates the motives behind this request, realizing that those using him aim to destabilize the Middle East and put Turkey in a difficult position. Those who revived Polat have already executed their plans for Nergiz, Doğu, and Esat. Elif fights for her life on the operating table, while Safiye wakes up in a room without doors, certain she'll be killed. Kılıç escapes the trap and disappears. As Polat's attempts to reach Istanbul are still thwarted, Nizamettin announces the first step of his war against the mafia and terrorism to the press.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: Polat faces a sniper while trying to prevent an assassination attempt on the Lebanese Prime Minister, as Elif fights for her life on the operating table. Polat's efforts to reach Istanbul are still being thwarted. New allegations claim Polat has fled abroad after committing billion-dollar murders. Council member Tuncay is arrested, while İplikçi Nedim is released. Halo manages to hide without leaving a trace. Memati escapes the police and tries to meet with Erhan and Abdülhey. Nizamettin claims Polat no longer exists and advises everyone to stay away from his contacts. However, Nizamettin will be the first person Safiye sees while awaiting her death. Elif remains unconscious, fighting for her life. Polat's priority is to prevent the assassination of the Lebanese Prime Minister, unable to get news about his loved ones.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: Polat, having defeated two snipers, realizes there are other plans for the Lebanese Prime Minister's assassination. While trying to dispose of a body, he faces a new problem. In Istanbul, Elif's loved ones are desperate as all doors close on them. Nizamettin cuts ties with everyone associated with Polat, including Elif. Memati, Abdülhey, and Erhan search for a hiding place. Tuncay finds himself in prison for trusting Abidin. Halo feels indebted to Polat. Laz Ziya learns to stay away from Nizamettin. Still unable to contact Istanbul, Polat devises a plan and briefly establishes contact. As the day of the assassination arrives, Polat's sole objective is to prevent the attack on the Prime Minister.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: Polat Alemdar escapes from the hell of Aleppo and arrives in Istanbul with Nevzat, both filled with questions. He seeks out Halo, whom he had specially hidden, but others also know Halo's location. While saving Halo's life, Polat realizes that all his loved ones are in even greater danger. He asks Halo about the status of Elif, Safiye, Memati, Abdülhey, Erhan, Nizamettin, Kılıç, Tuncay, and Laz Ziya. Unable to get news about Elif, who lies hopeless in the hospital, Polat decides to rescue his sister Safiye first. Coincidentally, the secret forces have also chosen Safiye as their first target among the remaining individuals.

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Upon learning about Elif's condition, Polat changes all his plans to reach her. Safiye faces either her brother Efe Karahanlı or Polat Alemdar, whom she believes has come to kill her. In shock, Safiye can't believe she might become a fratricide if she pulls the trigger again. Memati, unable to accept that Polat and Abdülhey are KGT agents, feels betrayed and leaves the team. Elif's gangrenous leg is scheduled for amputation, though she wishes for death to end her suffering. Nizamettin contacts the "Global Council" and is instructed to acquire the "Black Box of Turkey" from Karahanlı's house and eliminate everyone. Kılıç finds his own way to hide, intending to stay hidden until he finds answers. For Polat, only one goal remains before the end: reaching Elif.

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: For Polat Alemdar, being located is more dangerous than being wounded. Every corner of the hospital is surrounded by the police. Those who want to save him have to do something in their own way. Hikmet cannot escape arrest in this effort. When Safiye sees the relic Halo told her about, she realizes that it is not something ordinary. When she learns that what she sees is a cryptex and the “Black Box” of all secrets, a conflict awaits her. Kılıç has found answers to the questions in his head one by one. Now that he knows where to start, he decides to get out of the prison where he is hiding. For Polat, it is time to share the truth and his plans with his loved ones. In fact, this is a fork in the road for everyone...

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: Polat reveals the truth about himself. Polat begins to tell all his loved ones the truth about himself. In fact, this is both a farewell and a parting of the ways. Safiye, Halo and Memati, who do not find Polat's explanations sufficient, still want to know something more. Two important things remain for Polat. The first is to find the password and key needed to open the cryptex, and the second is to determine Nizamettin's connections. Elif's condition is getting worse and worse. Her only wish is to die as soon as possible. Kılıç secretly returns to Istanbul and tries to reach Nizamettin. When this surprise meeting takes place, everyone who tries to put together the cryptex, cipher and key will learn what they have and how much they have...

videos.title: Episode 95
videos.overview: Polat and Nizamettin face off. At the end of Kılıç's surprise meeting with Nizamettin, everyone fighting for the cryptex has realized what the enemy has. Polat has the code and Nizamettin has the key. While Memati regrets not being able to protect Abdülhey, Nesrin's mistake will cost Laz Ziya dearly. Polat's ability to take action depends on reaching Nizamettin's connections. Elif, who has to live connected to the devices, is shocked by who comes to her. While Nizamettin bargains for Abdülhey's life, he also learns where Polat and his men are hiding. Polat will comply with Nizamettin's request.

videos.title: Episode 96
videos.overview: Sharon Stone and Andy Garcia in Valley of the Wolves: Is Özal dead or murdered? Who sold Saddam the poison gas for the Halabja massacre? What is the September 11 assassins' connection to Turkey? And Polat Alemdar is in Los Angeles! Will Polat's pen be broken as he goes up against World Baron Amon (Andy Garcia) and Lisa (Sharon Stone)?

videos.title: Episode 97
videos.overview: The big finale of Valley of the Wolves! Polat Alemdar, who was born Efe Yakup Karahanlı, grew up as Ali Candan, then changed his face and his whole life, confronts the world barons on his way to crush the mafia. Will Polat, who risks everything to protect those he loves, be able to do the same against Lisa and Amon? On the other side, his beloved Elif, whom he could not give up even after becoming Polat Alemdar, is dying. Will Polat be able to see his beloved one last time before she dies? As Operation Valley of the Wolves comes to an end, Polat is answering for his loved ones and his life in court. How will Polat appear in court? What awaits him in court?
